notes: kb/Work PB5442 landed. SR1: "Sections and/or paragraphs wholly contained in one or more non-independent segments." The range is the executed one (§1985:VI.6.21.4 GR11: "The range includes all statements that are executed as the result of a transfer of control by CALL, EXIT, GO TO, and PERFORM statements in the range of the PERFORM statement"), and a violation has an undefined result (§1985:I.1.6), so which violations are diagnosed is WiseOwl's choice (docs/CONFORMANCE.md §3.8). Segmentation.CheckProcedures asks the named span and, only when it breaks the rule, the sections of it that execution reaches by fall-through and GO TO (Segmentation.ReachedPcs; an alterable GO TO also reaches each ALTER destination), refusing COBOL6877 when those break RangeAllowed; nested PERFORM, SORT and MERGE ranges are their own statements' (CCVS-85 SG102A, SG103A). Witnesses: the row's refusal witness and the pb5442 programs, where a GO TO jumps over a section of another segment (accepted, A C DONE), and its control, where it reaches it (refused).

next.reason: 1985: "Sections and/or paragraphs wholly contained in one or more non-independent segments."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the Segmentation feature; no candidate mentions segments or non-independent segments.". No 2023 clause holds the Segmentation feature, and no candidate addresses segments or their program-flow restrictions, so the feature and this rule are dropped.
